name: As If
description: Yılmaz and İlkkan are two friends who are constantly fighting each other. Their biggest feature is always being able to do things that will turn their ordinary lives upside down. They magnify small events incredibly and give you a nervous breakdown. They are the embodiment of the misfortunes, strange events and despair we experience every day.

videos.title: Kokaric

Even if you have to be cruel to be kind, you need to pat them on the back. Choose your friends among the ones who don't hide their love behind the shoulder paddings, not the ones who don't wear a jacket with shoulder paddings.

videos.overview: While enjoying the pleasure of receiving free spiritual help in the mysterious world of esoteric teachings, the residents of the neighborhood, who were suddenly shaken by the shock of witnessing a talent granted to very few people, have not yet been able to digest what has happened, and this time they will face a dermatological surprise plucked from the yellowed leaves of history.

A heartbreaking story of separation that focuses on intersectionality.

videos.title: Shako Bosphorus
videos.overview: Ilkkan, who has a splendid relationship with his repulsive boss, will find himself in the dreadful atmosphere of a fantastic restaurant dealing with the nauseating consequences of a perfect dinner invitation, while trying to balance the terrific compliments he receives outside of work with the terrible insults he faces at the workplace. Amidst his best friends' disgraceful advice, he'll have to make a choice.

videos.title: Absence
videos.overview: In the light of the dilemma of whether to hold onto their dignity or to give it up, a group of people who refuse luxury but never compromise their integrity find themselves on the brink of giving up in the marathon of life after a long period of starvation. As they ponder whether they can endure a bit more or if they should abandon their dignity, they embark on a journey through the past, their roots, and Dilovası.

videos.title: Kidney stone
videos.overview: Trapped in the triangle of kidney pain, slipped discs, and morbid obesity, three friends find themselves nearing the brink of insanity as they also fall into the quagmire of addiction. To make matters worse, they face the increasingly totalitarian Yılmaz's audacious attempt to rescue a failing marriage, pushing them to their limits. However, with unexpected help from an unlikely friend, they begin to take slow but determined strokes towards the hope of resolving both the marriage and medical problems at hand.

videos.title: Vile Man Covered in Blood
videos.overview: Yılmaz and Ersoy go to the solo exhibition opened by Ilkkan's recently separated painter girlfriend. However, events unfold in a completely unexpected way. Ilkkan, upon learning about the situation, shows a very harsh reaction. However, events unfold in a completely unexpected way. Gallery owner Nazmi takes charge of the situation and promises to solve the problem on behalf of our group. However, events unfold in a completely unexpected way.

videos.title: Leopard And…

videos.title: Shadan

videos.title: Will

videos.title: Young Adults, Harbingers of the Future

videos.title: Kenan Trading
videos.overview: When Kenan Ticaret, the liveliest millionaire in the region, fails in customer relations, Yılmaz, whose sense of justice is damaged, hands over his revenge project, which was fueled by the negative effects the same business had on Ersoy, to the peace-loving hands of art. Nothing will ever be the same for Kenan Ticaret.

videos.title: Ravens of the Iron Keep: Legacy of the Necromancer
videos.overview: Three adventurers take on a mission given by the local lord in a town they are staying in. There is only one problem left: to survive, albeit disgracefully, in a dangerous world full of ambitious thieves, orcs, goblins, wizards, witches, all due to their incredibly amateur nature!

videos.title: Ravens of the Iron Keep: Guardians of the Wooden Ark
